definitions.supplemental: blác II. pale, hleór a face, cheek
definitions.meaning: Having a pale face, pale-faced, fair

quotations.old_english: Sceolde monig bláchleór ides bifiende gán
quotations.english: many a pale-faced damsel must trembling go

source_text: blác-hleór; adj. [blác II. pale, hleór a face, cheek] Having a pale face, pale-faced, fair; pallidus vel candidus genis :-- Sceolde monig bláchleór ides bifiende gán many a pale-faced damsel must trembling go, Cd. 92; Th. 118, 23-25; Gen. 1969, 1970: Judth. 11; Thw. 23, 18; Jud. 128.
